## Highlights
### Fixed
- The sidebar hides and shows more smoothly, the History, Archive and Downloads selector closes back to its button, and History, Archive or Downloads opened over a hidden sidebar stays open while you use the page.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
